column3: A SINGLE SEAMLESS TILEABLE PBR TEXTURE (ignore any landscape framing in the art direction: SQUARE 1:1 image, the whole frame is the material, no border, no labels, no objects, no horizon, no perspective). Orthographic top-down photographic scan of 3 m x 3 m of real surface, flat even cross-polarised light: NO highlights, NO reflections, NO shadows from a key light, NO vignette, NO painted wetness (wetness and gloss are added later by the shader). Edges must wrap seamlessly left-right and top-bottom. Rich believable real-world detail at true scale, varied so it does not look repetitive, matching the colours of the attached concept images. Material: travertine rimstone / sinter terrace surface seen from above: cream and pale grey calcite with rounded botryoidal lobes, micro-gour rims a few cm high forming small scalloped pools, faint ochre and rust flow stains running downslope, a few darker damp hollows.
